title: De-dollarisation and its impact on commodities and global trade
text: De-dollarisation and its impact on commodities and global trade. For decades, the US dollar has dominated global trade and commodity markets. Most commodities, including crude oil, natural gas, gold, industrial metals, and agricultural products, are priced and traded in dollars.
